deadline.value: Apply by February 1 for first priority for scholarships; the final deadline for September entry is April 30.
deadline.quote: If we receive your application for a September start by February 1 (well ahead of the final submission deadline), you will receive first priority for internal and entrance scholarships.

also.quote: (**Early app. deadline is February 1) | September - April 30

gre_subject.value: The department does not require the GRE; the Chemistry Subject test is not mentioned.

supervisor.value: You don't need a supervisor to apply, but contacting potential supervisors first is strongly encouraged.
supervisor.quote: We recommend prospective students review faculty members' research interests and contact potential supervisors

also.quote: you do not have to secure a supervisor in order to apply

funding.value: Every admitted student without a full scholarship receives a stipend (TA plus a CAD 17,750 PhD research scholarship); international PhD students are paid the same as domestic.
funding.quote: All students who are accepted into the graduate program and do not hold a scholarship designed to cover all or part of these costs receive a graduate stipend. | Visa PhD students pay the same tuition and are compensated in the same way as their domestic counterparts.

entry_route.value: PhD entry needs a B+ (9/12) master's, or an A (11/12) bachelor's for direct entry.
entry_route.quote: For the PhD program, you need 9/12 (B+) in an MSc or 11/12 (A) in a BSc.

gre_general.value: The GRE General Test is not required (you may still submit it).
gre_general.quote: The GRE General Test is not a required document.

fee_waiver.value: The program cannot waive the fee, but a supervisor willing to take you may pay it from research funds in exceptional circumstances.
fee_waiver.quote: as a program, we do not have the ability to waive the application fee | they have the option to pay your application fee for you out of their research funding if you face exceptional circumstances

english_waiver.value: Waived only if your university degree was taught in English; official documentation may be requested.
english_waiver.quote: Yes, but only if you have completed a university degree at an institution where the language of instruction is English (we may ask for official documentation to show this).
